newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mirvac mulls property trust merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mirvac mulls property trust merger.

text.p: Mirvac Ltd said on Wednesday it was examining the possibility of merging the two listed property trusts that it manages, Mirvac Property Trust and Capital Property Trust.
"It is a complex problem and we are not at this stage convinced that we can merge them and protect the interests of both unitholders," Mirvac managing director Robert Hamilton told a news conference.
"However. we are examining (the merger) in detail and hopefully we can work out the problems and put forward a proposal by the end of the year," he said.

Mirvac acquired the Capital Property Management Ltd (CPM), the manager of the Capital Property Trust in November last year. The company resumed full control of Mirvac Funds Ltd, the management company for the Mirvac Property Trust a month later following the decision of Barclays Bank Plc to combine its funds management activities under the Barclays Global Investors label.
Hamilton said a merger would be good for unitholders because a bigger fund would be re-rated by the investment community.
"Being re-rated, it will attract far more investment as a larger trust and the combined unit value will go up," Hamilton said.
Mirvac would benefit from the economies of scale created by managing the combined trusts with just the one management company, Hamilton said.
Hamilton said one of the problems in merging the trusts was that Mirvac Property Trust was far more diversified than Capital, which was principally a commercial fund.
